title: lncRNA-aware single-cell re-analysis of the human Liver Cell Atlas: code and result tables
description: Analysis code, intermediate result tables, donor-level validation, and independent-cohort replication for the manuscript "MEG3 is a donor-reproducible endothelial lncRNA replicated across two human liver single-cell atlases" (Hidenori Tani). Includes an lncRNA-aware single-cell feature-selection pipeline, a donor-level detection-rate validation framework, and a replication of the MEG3-in-LSEC result in the independent MacParland et al. 2018 atlas. Primary data are public via GEO accessions GSE192742 (Guilliams et al. 2022) and GSE115469 (MacParland et al. 2018) and are not redistributed here.
